title: Edge AI Classification Taxonomy
description: Reference taxonomy used to classify AI paper abstracts into Edge AI vs Non-Edge AI.

notes: Use semantic match, not exact keyword match only.
Do not classify as edge_ai when abstract is cloud-only with no edge or device deployment intent.

subdomains.label: On-device Inference
subdomains.description: Model inference directly on edge devices such as phones, cameras, IoT modules, or embedded boards.

subdomains.label: Model Compression for Edge
subdomains.description: Compression or optimization methods to fit AI models within edge hardware limits.

subdomains.label: Hardware-aware AI
subdomains.description: AI methods co-designed with hardware constraints such as memory, compute budget, and power.

subdomains.label: Distributed Edge Learning
subdomains.description: Learning paradigms where model updates or adaptation occur on edge devices.

field_definitions.evidence: array of short strings from abstract/title that justify classification

few_shot_hints.input_hint: Model for real-time vision inference on Raspberry Pi using int8 quantization.
LLM serving optimization across cloud GPU clusters with no device deployment.
